title: [Audit] Actor first-seen and footprint
description: Every identity with first/last seen, event count, distinct client IPs and countries. New rows appearing here are new identities in your estate.
esql: FROM logs-serverless.audit.otel-elastic_cloud | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | STATS first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), events = COUNT(*), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip), countries = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.geo.country_iso_code), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.event.action) BY actor | SORT first_seen DESC | LIMIT 200
